summary: Console dashboard panel goes blank when timeframe crosses retention cutoff
description:
Issue summary:
When a dashboard time range spans the ingestion retention boundary (e.g., 'now-90d to now'), large panels that fan out multiple series return a completely blank panel in the Console UI. Traces and raw events for the same timeframe are still queryable via the Trace view and raw exports. The blank panel occurs intermittently and appears correlated with panels that run queries hitting older hourly/rollup tables plus the recent hot partition.

Impact:
- Customer-facing dashboards appear empty for large time ranges crossing retention cutoffs.
- Users at Zypher Analytics (enterprise, heavy historical analytics) report inability to reconcile metrics with exported CSVs.
- Affects dashboards with >10 series across combined storage layers; can impact downstream alerts that depend on panel series.

Environment:
- prod | us-east (primary reports), also observed in eu-west during repro.
- Console version: web-2026.03.01
- Query-service: q-2.8.4, retention-worker: r-1.5.2

Steps to reproduce:
1) Login to Console as org admin for Zypher Analytics (org-id: zypher-001).
2) Open Dashboard 'Customer Latency — 90d Overview' (contains 12 series, split by route/model).
3) Set time range to custom: now-90d to now.
4) Click Refresh.
5) Observe panel rendering: some panels display, the large latency heatmap panel remains blank with no error.
6) Switch to Trace view for the same timeframe -> traces are visible and exportable.
7) Repeat with narrower window (now-89d to now) -> panel renders correctly.

Observed behavior:
- Blank panel (no series, no error message); browser console shows XHR 502 occasionally from query-service that is not surfaced in the UI.
- Query-service logs show a short-window SQL planner fallback and an upstream 504 in a small percentage of fanout shards.
- When blank occurs, panel-level alerting for missing series does not trigger because the UI treats the response as empty instead of error.

Expected behavior:
- Panel should render series where data exists. When one or more shards/time-partitions fail, the UI should surface a clear error and optionally render partial results. Alerts that depend on missing-series detection should consider query errors as failures rather than silent empties.

Logs / diagnostic artifacts attached to issue (customer-provided):
- Browser console HAR (redacted)
- Panel query payload and response snippets showing 502 from q-service
- Customer CSV export for same timeframe that contains non-empty rows

Additional notes:
- Customer only sees this when the query triggers cross-layer aggregation (hourly rollups + live partitions). Panels that query single layer (fully hot or fully rolled-up) do not reproduce.
- Initial hypothesis: query fanout to rollup tables uses a promisified fetch path that swallows a non-fatal shard error and returns an empty payload to UI renderer.
investigation_notes: 03-10 10:45 - Support (Maya): Received report from Zypher CS rep. Collected HAR, panel query and time range.
03-10 11:10 - Eng (Rory): Reproduced in prod on us-east with synthetic dashboard; able to reproduce ~30% of runs.
03-10 12:05 - Eng: Found query-service returns 502 for specific shard range (hourly_rollup_2025-12 to hourly_rollup_2026-01) when fanout includes both rollup and hot partitions.
03-11 09:20 - SRE: Identified that the retention-worker triggered a compaction job touching rollup metadata on 2026-03-09 which increased query latency for older shards for ~10m windows.
03-11 11:00 - Eng: Added extra logging around shard responses; observed that HTTP client layer treats 502 as recoverable and returns empty series to caller.
03-12 08:30 - Eng: Created PR to change error propagation policy so shard errors surface as recoverable partial-fail with explicit error waterfall to UI (see related_github_prs).
03-12 09:15 - Eng: Temporary mitigation: add UI-side guard to surface 'Partial data — check query logs' when any shard returned non-200. Patch deployed to staging for smoke tests.
03-12 10:00 - CS: Notified Zypher of investigation progress and recommended narrow time window as temporary workaround.
comments: Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-10: Customer reports blank panel affecting executive dashboard; provided HAR and CSV exports. Awaiting triage.
Rory Patel (Eng) 2026-03-10: Reproduced intermittently in prod. Query-service 502s observed for mixed-layer fanout. WIP to add shard-level error bubble to UI.
Alisha Rao (SRE) 2026-03-11: Compaction job coincided with incident window; verifying if compaction scheduling can be staggered to avoid hotspots.
Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-12: Customer accepted temporary workaround (restrict range to not cross retention boundary). Requested ETA for permanent fix and note for runbook.
Rory Patel (Eng) 2026-03-12: PR opened and smoke tests passing in staging. Targeting canary deploy for prod tomorrow.
resolution_notes: In progress. Temporary customer workaround: avoid dashboard time ranges that cross retention boundary (e.g., use now-89d). Engineering patch to propagate shard errors to UI has PR opened and staged. Post-deploy follow-up: runbook update to alert on shard 502s and ensure alerts treat query errors as failures for panel rendering. Will update ticket when canary completes.
